note: Bloomberg Connects: which museums and venues of the Artist Website have a guide of their own, by hand from the searches, read by scripts/fetch_bloomberg_guides.py, which writes docs/v2/bloomberg.json. A url is only ever an address seen verbatim (seen: where; as_seen: the link it was the root of); never a guide id made up or guessed. status: guide (evidenced; url null until its address is seen, and then nothing shows), unconfirmed (one weak source: kept off the page until an own page confirms it), none (searched, nothing found). pages: the institution's own pages the fetch script may read for the address (their robots.txt kept); Bloomberg's own sites are never read (guides.bloombergconnects.org forbids all robots; www.bloombergconnects.org is behind bot protection). holds: what the guide holds, in the institution's own description, only where it was seen.
searched: 7 Oct 2026: a web search for “"<name>" "Bloomberg Connects"” for each of the 123 museums and the Folger (again with other words where the first was unclear), and, where a search was cheap, for about fifty of the cities' other museums and art centres (16 searches, several names each); GitHub code search for bloombergconnects.org links; the English Wikipedia's index of external links to bloombergconnects.org.
